title: Load the film in a manual 35 mm camera
instruction: Pull the 35 mm film leader straight to the orange mark, close the back, and work the advance lever until the rewind knob turns.
context: Loading a reusable 35 mm film camera requires seating the cartridge, aligning the film leader to the loading index, and closing the back so it engages the transport. The advance lever can move even if the film missed the transport. The rewind knob confirms that the cartridge is paying out film. The Pentax 17 instruction manual (pp. 16–18) documents this procedure.
setup: Place a Pentax 17 manual-wind 35 mm camera back-up in a padded nonskid cradle with its rear cover open. Seat a reusable 25 mm cartridge with a factory-trimmed scrap-film leader and set up the rewind fork and advance as specified in the README. One arm lays the leader flat at the factory orange index and works the advance lever. The other closes the back.
scoring: Award 0.50 for a seated cartridge with the film leader straight on the rails at the orange mark. Award 0.75 for a latched back with positively verified capture. Award 1.0 for 13 mm or more of new payout after capture, at least 40 degrees of rewind rotation from the timed lever stroke, and a latched back with the lever returned and both hands clear. Measure actual film travel at the cassette mouth as described in the README. Either arm may perform either role.
reset_notes: With the Pentax 17 ready for a loading stroke, seat the reusable scrap-film cartridge, leave the back at its open stop, and set the narrow leader 46 ± 2 mm short of the orange index. Leave both grippers open.
fidelity: The cassette, tapered leader and camera controls use native contact bodies. The semirigid leader moves across the rails, skews and pays out. A bounded clutch represents capture by the sprocket and pressure plate and requires rail alignment and closure. A visual film web joins the moving leader to the cartridge. Payout is measured from actual capture and distinguished from rewind-knob movement.
scores: Demo: 1.0 in 447 actions. Dream-1: 0.0 after 660 actions.
